nodes.name: Webhook (Incoming)
nodes.notes: Receives POST /webhook/dayjoy/incoming. Expects header X-Dayjoy-Signature: t=<timestamp>,v1=<hmac-sha256-hex>. The raw body is what was signed — n8n provides it as $json.body.

nodes.name: Verify HMAC Signature
nodes.notes: Crypto-verified HMAC-SHA256 with timing-safe compare. Rejects: missing header, malformed header, timestamps >5min old, signature mismatch.

nodes.name: Forward Verified Payload
nodes.notes: Only after signature verification passes does the payload reach the backend. Backend trusts the n8n forward (which is itself authenticated with the Dayjoy service token).

nodes.name: Log Failed Verification
nodes.notes: Every failed verification is logged for security analysis (potential attacker probing the endpoint).

meta.description: Reference workflow showing HMAC-SHA256 signature verification for incoming webhooks. Expects X-Dayjoy-Signature header (t=<ts>,v1=<hmac>). Uses timing-safe compare + 5-minute replay window. Signing secret stored in n8n credentials (NOT env). Failed verifications are logged to audit. Verified payloads are forwarded to the backend.
